style: Premium mobile card-game illustration with a 'prime time' cable-news look: deep navy and royal blue, crimson red, warm gold highlights. Dramatic studio lighting, soft gradients, glossy finish, subtle film grain, semi-realistic stylized forms, crisp silhouettes that read at small sizes. Same lighting, palette and rendering in every cell.
portraitStyle: Head-and-shoulders character portrait, facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle, eyes level, the same framing and scale in every cell (top of head near the top edge, shoulders reaching the bottom edge). Smooth navy-to-crimson studio backdrop with a soft gold rim light. Semi-realistic stylized illustration, friendly and expressive, diverse ages and ethnicities as described.
layout: One image, 1536 x 1024 pixels, a grid of 6 columns and 4 rows of equal square cells (each about 248 x 248 pixels) separated by straight solid #0B1430 gutters about 8 pixels wide, including an 8-pixel gutter around the outside edge. Each cell holds exactly one subject, centered, filling the cell edge to edge. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, labels or borders anywhere.
